posts.raw_content:
When Trump got back in and started signing EOs, everyone kept saying he did more to change the government in 100 hours than others did in 100 days. A lot of his EOs fulfilling kept promises ran into walls at the Supreme Court, but that doesn't invalidate that he tried. Too many people either sound like undercover Dem operatives or let the "GEOTUS" hype warp their expectations into thinking he was a dictator. Now that he's tried pushing everything he said he would through a backstabbing, obstructionist Congress, people are whining that he isn't going far enough or doing things precisely how they personally want it done. Everyone has their own specific window for what MAGA should look like, and they throw a fit when reality doesn't match their 100% pure blueprint.

Look at the Iran situation. The man has been a hawk against Iran for 30 years and openly slammed the nuclear deal from day one. He didn't campaign on pulling us out of every single entangling alliance overnight, but I'm damn glad he's dismantling them now. Before moving on Iran, he systematically boosted global oil supplies, hit narcoterrorist boats, and cut off money to Venezuela to squeeze their regime before opening up the planet's largest oil reserves. That timeline was chosen by the U.S., not Israel.

Speaking of Israel, of course they benefit from us dealing with Iran, but let's not suffer from historical amnesia. Iran started this war back in 1979 by capturing our embassy and humiliating us for over a year. It was Iranian-backed proxies that bombed Lebanon, slaughtering hundreds of Marines in the barracks bombing, and let's not forget how many thousands of U.S. troops were killed or mutilated in Iraq by Iranian-supplied EFPs and networks orchestrated by figures like Soleimani. Neutralizing a regime that has American blood on its hands for decades isn't just about helping Israel; it's about settling a massive, overdue score for the United States.

Trump has kept nearly all of his promises. Don't let the perfect be the enemy of the great, and stop pretending we should have ever voted for Kamala just because Trump doesn't check every single box of your personal purity test 100% of the time.
